scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
Soon we'll face a decisive war.
I'll do my best to fulfill my duty as the Guardian.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
一場決定性的戰爭即將打響。
我會竭盡全力履行我作為守護者的職責。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
I hope you'll like my gift. Yggdrasil's blessing doesn't last forever, 
but it'll last at least long enough to aid you and your party in battle.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
希望你能喜歡我的禮物。世界樹的賜福雖然不會永遠持續，
但足以在戰鬥中助你和你的隊伍一臂之力。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
Oh, it's a shard of his soul.
He's destined to endlessly roam the world that he's created in his mind.
Vengeance is meted out, but the results aren't as satisfying as I thought.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
哦，那是他靈魂的一角。
他註定要在自己腦海中構建的世界裡無盡地遊蕩。
復仇雖然得以實現，但結果卻不如我預期的那樣令人滿足。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
I don't understand this;
I badly wanted to get rid of him from this world,
yet I feel like I'm empty on the inside.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
我不明白這是怎麼回事；
我明明迫切地想將他從這個世界上抹去，
內心卻感到一片空虛。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
I'm preparing a gift for you to make up for my past transgressions against you.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
我正在準備一份禮物，以彌補我過去對你犯下的過錯。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
May I have this Soul Shard?
In exchange, I'll give you and your party
the biggest gift I can give.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
能把這塊靈魂碎片交給我嗎？
作為交換，我會給你和你的隊伍
我能給出的最大禮物。

scripts.text: Give the Soul Shard.
scripts.translation: 交出靈魂碎片

scripts.text: Decline.
scripts.translation: 拒絕

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
Watch out for the Demon God's negative influence on you.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
小心惡魔之神對你的負面影響。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
Oh, you already received Yggdrasil's blessing.
I'll take a rain check on this.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
哦，你已經獲得了世界樹的賜福。
這次就先算了吧。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
Thank you.
May Yggdrasil bless you.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
謝謝。
願世界樹賜福於你。

scripts.text: ^4d4dffGood job taking out Demon God Morocc. The server EXP rate has increased by 10% for about 1 hour.^000000
scripts.translation: ^4d4dff恭喜擊敗惡魔之神莫洛奇。伺服器經驗值獲取率將在約1小時內提升10%。^000000

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
This must be
how people feel when they've lost their jobs overnight.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
這大概就是人們一夜之間失業時的感受吧。

scripts.text:
[Nidhogg]
At least I've saved enough money
to go without a job for a while.
scripts.translation:
[尼德霍格]
至少我存夠了錢，可以暫時不用工作。

[洛基]
事情甚至還沒開始；
只有當他露出真面目時，一切才會真正開始。

scripts.text:
You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest.
Please make some room in your inventory.
scripts.translation:
你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續任務。
請清理一些背包空間。

scripts.text:
[Magic Scholar]
Stop bothering me.
If you're here to donate your body for my experiment, then you can stay.
Or scram!
scripts.translation:
[魔法學者]
別煩我。
如果你是為了捐獻身體供我實驗而來的，那你可以留下。
否則就滾！

scripts.text:
[Avant]
What brings you, rookie?
Did you come to laugh at my misery, like everyone else?
scripts.translation:
[阿旺]
什麼事，新人？
你是來嘲笑我的悲慘遭遇，像其他人一樣嗎？

scripts.text: Why are you here?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼在這裡？

scripts.text: Are you sorry for what you've done?
scripts.translation: 你對你做過的事感到後悔嗎？

scripts.text:
[Avant]
*Snort*
This is a matter of pride.
I admit that my action sent my kinsmen in harm's way.
scripts.translation:
[阿旺]
*哼*
這是關乎尊嚴的事。
我承認，我的行為讓我的族人陷入了危險。

scripts.text:
[Avant]
I want to say that I'm doing this to make up for what I did,
like everyone wants to believe. *Smirk*
scripts.translation:
[阿旺]
我想說，我這麼做是為了彌補我所做的一切，
就像大家希望相信的那樣。*冷笑*

scripts.text:
[Avant]
But if I'm honest with myself,
I'm doing this to get back at Shnaim and Morocc for using me like a tool.
scripts.translation:
[阿旺]
但如果我對自己誠實一點的話，
我這麼做是為了報復施奈姆和摩洛哥，
因為他們把我當成工具使用。

scripts.text:
[Avant]
I'm planning to be the last one standing after everything goes down.
scripts.translation:
[阿旺]
我計劃在所有事情結束後，
成為最後站著的人。

scripts.text:
[Avant]
I've got no use for weaklings.
Come back when you become stronger.
scripts.translation:
[阿旺]
我對弱者毫無興趣。
等你變強一點再來吧。

scripts.text:
[Avant]
Not bad, rookie.
Let me take the Mana Crystallines.
Good job.
scripts.translation:
[阿旺]
不錯，新人。
把魔力結晶交給我吧。
幹得好。

scripts.text:
[Avant]
Greenhorn, if you defeat those strong Demons, you'll find some mana crystallines.
I want you to bring them to me,
at least three at a time. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[阿旺]
菜鳥，如果你打敗那些強大的惡魔，
就能找到一些魔力結晶。
我要你帶給我，
每次至少三個。明白了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Avant]
Hey, rookie.
Do you see those massive goons?
If you hunt those Distorted,
scripts.translation:
[阿旺]
嘿，新人。
你看到那些大塊頭了嗎？
如果你獵殺那些扭曲的...

scripts.text:
[Avant]
Blazing, and Freezing Reincarnations, you'll find some mana crystallines.
Part of mana stolen from the orb, the crystallines are what
make those Demon runts so strong.
scripts.translation:
[阿旺]
...燃燒和冰凍轉生體，就能找到一些魔力結晶。
這些結晶是從魔球中偷走的魔力的一部分，
正是它們讓那些惡魔幼崽變得如此強大。

scripts.text:
[Avant]
I want you to
get rid of them and bring me Mana Crystallines.
Don't try to keep them from me: they're not useful for you.
scripts.translation:
[阿旺]
我要你
消滅它們，並把魔力結晶帶給我。
別想私藏：它們對你沒什麼用。

scripts.text:
[Avant]
Three Reincarnations, thus three Mana Crystallines.
Bring them at least for Kardui of Eclage.
scripts.translation:
[阿旺]
三個轉生體，也就是三個魔力結晶。
至少為埃克拉珠的卡爾杜伊帶回來。

scripts.text:
[Avant]
Hm, I didn't know such a small amount of mana could produce
such great power.
Dirty Demons.
scripts.translation:
[阿旺]
嗯，我沒想到這麼少的魔力
能產生這麼大的力量。
骯髒的惡魔。

scripts.text:
[Avant]
I hope you'll come back for the next subjugation.
scripts.translation:
[阿旺]
希望下次鎮壓惡魔時你能回來。

scripts.text:
[Avant]
Soon the Human Alliance will send out a Demon subjugation party. Come by before you leave.
You want to collect the mana, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[阿旺]
很快人類聯盟就會派出惡魔鎮壓隊伍。離開前過來一趟。
你想收集魔力，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Hishieh]
Are you from the Human Alliance?
I don't remember asking for your assistance, yet.
scripts.translation:
[希謝]
你是人類聯盟的人？
我不記得我請求過你們的援助。

scripts.text:
[Hishieh]
Can we really learn the truth about the Demon God in this place?
It's filled with creatures I've never seen.
scripts.translation:
[希謝]
我們真的能在這個地方
瞭解關於惡魔神的真相嗎？
這裡充滿了我從沒見過的生物。

scripts.text:
[Hishieh]
The instigator of all the bad things is really hiding out in here, huh?
How exciting!
scripts.translation:
[希謝]
所有壞事的主謀真的藏在這裡，是嗎？
真令人興奮！

scripts.text:
[Hishieh]
The Temple of the Demon God, huh? Okay, well if you find stray mana from the orb in there, could you take care of it?
I don't know what kind of shape the mana is taking at the moment, but you won't mistake it for anything else.
scripts.translation:
[希謝]
惡魔神的寺廟，是吧？好吧，如果你在裡面發現魔球散落的魔力，能處理一下嗎？
我不知道魔力現在是什麼形態，但你不會把它和其他東西搞混的。

scripts.text:
[Hishieh]
Avant knows about the orb's mana better than anyone else.
Even Kar and I can barely stand Avant, but he really needs your help.
scripts.translation:
[希謝]
阿旺比任何人都瞭解魔球的魔力。
即使我和卡爾都很難忍受阿旺，但他確實需要你的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Hishieh]
All you have to do is just hit and disperse the moving globes of mana in the Temple of the Demon God.
Then the mana will be returned to Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation:
[希謝]
你只需要攻擊並驅散惡魔神寺廟中移動的魔力球。
然後魔力就會迴歸世界樹。

scripts.text:
[Hishieh]
Good job!
I've felt the mana returning.
You did great. Kar will be excited!
scripts.translation:
[希謝]
幹得好！
我感覺到魔力正在迴歸。
你做得很棒。卡爾會很興奮的！

scripts.text:
[Hishieh]
Not all the stray globes of mana from the orb have been retrieved,
though we're making progress.
I'll appreciate if you can come back tomorrow and help us again.
scripts.translation:
[希謝]
雖然魔球散落的魔力球還沒有全部回收，
但我們在取得進展。
如果你明天能回來再幫一次忙，我會很感激的。

scripts.text:
[Hishieh]
If you're planning to reenter the Temple of the Demon God, then I'd like to ask you a favor.
Yes, it's the same thing I asked you before:
return the mana.
scripts.translation:
[希謝]
如果你打算再次進入惡魔神的寺廟，我想請你幫個忙。
是的，還是之前拜託你的那件事：
回收魔力。

scripts.text: [Hishieh]
scripts.translation: [希謝]

scripts.text:
[Hishieh]
If something were to happen, I'd send word to your commander-in-chief, Hibba Agip.
scripts.translation:
[希謝]
如果出了什麼事，我會向你的最高指揮官希巴·阿吉普通報。

scripts.text:
[Hishieh]
Creepy...
scripts.translation:
[希謝]
真讓人毛骨悚然...

scripts.text:
[Hishieh]
Oh, why am I here?
I came on Kar's behalf.
He can't leave Eclage while supplying it with mana that the orb can't.
scripts.translation:
[希謝]
哦，我為什麼會在這裡？
我是代表卡爾來的。
在魔球無法提供魔力的情況下，他不能離開埃克拉珠。

scripts.text:
[Hishieh]
Our priorities lie with Yggdrasil and her Guardian.
Plus, we really can't afford to lose the newborn Mayor.
scripts.translation:
[希謝]
我們的首要任務是守護世界樹和她的守護者。
而且，我們真的不能失去新上任的市長。

scripts.text:
[Hishieh]
I was able to persuade the Elders to let me command the army,
but I'm still a commander in name only.
scripts.translation:
[希謝]
我成功說服長老們讓我指揮軍隊，
但我目前只是名義上的指揮官。

scripts.text: What happened to Avant?
scripts.translation: 阿旺怎麼了？

scripts.text:
[Hishieh]
Hm...
We're using his knowledge.
We could have killed him, but that would've been too easy.
scripts.translation:
[希謝]
嗯...
我們正在利用他的知識。
我們可以殺了他，但那太容易了。

scripts.text:
[Hishieh]
It's a kind of revenge I guess, huh.
After all, his only transgression is that he loves his science too much.
scripts.translation:
[希謝]
這大概算是一種復仇吧。
畢竟，他唯一的過錯就是太熱愛他的科學了。

scripts.text:
[Hishieh]
Even the Elders acknowledged his talent and decided to save his life.
Above all...
scripts.translation:
[希謝]
連長老們都認可了他的才華，決定饒他一命。
最重要的是...

scripts.text:
[Hishieh]
(Lowering his voice)
No one else knows the orb's mana has been stolen.
As far as others know, Avant's only responsible for me and Kar.
scripts.translation:
[希謝]
（壓低聲音）
除了我，沒人知道魔球的魔力被偷走了。
在別人眼裡，阿旺只負責我和卡爾。

scripts.text:
[Hishieh]
Avant's over there. You can ask him questions if you'd like.
Hah hah.
scripts.translation:
[希謝]
阿旺在那邊。如果你想的話，可以問他一些問題。
哈哈。

scripts.text:
[Hishieh]
If you find stray mana from the orb, then please hit and disperse it.
It'll find its way back to Yggdrasil and the orb.
Can you do that for us?
scripts.translation:
[希謝]
如果你發現魔球散落的魔力，請攻擊並驅散它。
它會迴歸世界樹和魔球。
你能幫我們做這個嗎？

scripts.text: Gladly.
scripts.translation: 樂意效勞。

scripts.text: Sorry.
scripts.translation: 抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Hishieh]
No worries.
I'll ask someone else.
We're good.
scripts.translation:
[希謝]
沒關係。
我會找別人。
我們沒問題。

scripts.text:
[Hishieh]
I owe you so much,
I don't know how to repay you.
Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[希謝]
我欠你太多了，
不知道該如何報答你。
謝謝你。

scripts.text:
[Hishieh]
Please release 3 Brilliant Manas, 3 Life Manas, and 3 Earth Manas.
I'll be counting on you.
Come back safely, you hear?
scripts.translation:
[希謝]
請釋放3個光輝魔力、3個生命魔力和3個大地魔力。
拜託你了。
一定要平安回來，聽到了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hishieh]
This isn't just about collecting the orb's mana, but also has to do with the Demon God.
Most of my kinsmen don't know yet the orb's core mana has been stolen.
scripts.translation:
[希謝]
這不僅僅是收集魔球的魔力，還和惡魔神有關。
我的大多數族人還不知道魔球的核心魔力被偷走了。

scripts.text:
[Hishieh]
And I want to keep it that way.
Please help us.
Kar and I really need you.
scripts.translation:
[希謝]
我想保持這種狀態。
請幫幫我們。
卡爾和我真的很需要你。

scripts.text:
[Hishieh]
If you find solidified, immobile mana, just absorb them
by touching it.
scripts.translation:
[希謝]
如果你發現已經凝固、無法移動的魔力，
直接觸碰它就可以將其吸收。

scripts.text:
[Hishieh]
It's no longer useful for us, but this is for you
to fight the Demons.
scripts.translation:
[希謝]
這對我們已經沒什麼用了，
但你可以用它來對抗惡魔。

scripts.text:
[Hishieh]
This isn't much, but I want you to have it.
Hope you'll like it.
A substantial amount of mana has been leaked out of the orb.
scripts.translation:
[希謝]
雖然不多，但我還是想給你。
希望你能喜歡。
魔球中洩漏出了大量的魔力。

scripts.text:
[Hishieh]
If you're planning to reenter the Temple of the Demon God, then please look for more mana globes.
You should go rest for now.
scripts.translation:
[希謝]
如果你打算再次進入惡魔神殿，
那就請尋找更多的魔力球。
現在你應該去休息了。

scripts.text:
[Hishieh]
Talk to me again if you want to help us.
scripts.translation:
[希謝]
如果你想幫助我們，
請再和我談談。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
This place is bizarre beyond comprehension.
Morocc is here somewhere.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
這個地方詭異得令人難以理解。
莫洛克就在附近的某個地方。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Ah, our hero is back!
Mwah hah hah, finally we've reached the end of our expedition!
Good job!
I thank you on behalf of the entire humankind.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
啊，我們的英雄回來了！
哇哈哈，我們的遠征終於到達終點了！
幹得好！
我代表全人類感謝你。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
The Temple of the Demon God is discovered inside the cave in the central hill.
A tree is blocking the entry to the temple.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
惡魔神殿被發現位於中央山丘的洞穴內部。
有一棵樹擋住了通往神殿的入口。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Well-met.
I've heard a path has been cleared in that dark cave.
Sometimes I think this condemned basin is alive.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
幸會。
我聽說那條黑暗的洞穴已經被清理出一條路了。
有時候我覺得這個被詛咒的盆地是活的。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
*Whistle* Good work!
How's the Temple of the Demon God?
Still the same?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
*吹口哨* 幹得好！
惡魔神殿的情況如何？
還是老樣子嗎？

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
For the life of me, I can't figure out what's happening.
This place has gone to the dogs since that monster proclaimed that he would replace God.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我實在想不通這裡到底發生了什麼。
自從那個怪物宣稱要取代上帝以來，
這個地方就徹底亂套了。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Now that we've taken care of the main body, we can take things slow.
Why don't you go rest for now?
Leave the rest to us.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
既然主要目標已經解決，
我們可以放慢節奏了。
你不妨先去休息？
剩下的交給我們。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I wouldn't believe you had an intense battle yesterday if I didn't already know about it.
Are you ready for another battle?
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
如果不是已經知道了，
我簡直不敢相信你昨天經歷了一場激烈的戰鬥。
你準備好再次戰鬥了嗎？

scripts.text: [Hibba Agip]
scripts.translation: [希巴·阿吉普]

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
This definitely looks abysmal enough for someone like him to hang around.
Those must have been dragged in from the Morocc Desert, then contaminated by his evil energy.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
這地方確實糟糕得足以讓那種人徘徊其中。
那些東西一定是從莫洛克沙漠被拖進來的，
然後被他的邪惡能量汙染了。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Sigh...
We have a long and winding load ahead of us.
...
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
唉...
我們前方還有漫長而曲折的路要走。
...

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Sigh.
I'll call you when I need you.
Till then, focus on staying alive.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
唉。
我需要你的時候會叫你的。
在那之前，專心活下去吧。

scripts.text:
[Adjutant Abidal]
You're incredible!
You've saved the world!
After this, I'm going to go back home...
scripts.translation:
[副官 阿比達爾]
你太不可思議了！
你拯救了世界！
之後，我要回家了...

scripts.text:
[Hiva Agip]
Abidal, enough!
Are you trying to raise a red flag?!
scripts.translation:
[希瓦·阿吉普]
阿比達爾，夠了！
你想引起注意嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Hiva Agip]
This isn't much, but I want you to have it.
Thank you for your service.
Hah hah.
Finally I can sleep!
scripts.translation:
[希瓦·阿吉普]
雖然不多，但我還是想給你。
感謝你的服務。
哈哈。
我終於可以好好睡一覺了！

scripts.text:
[Hiva Agip]
Wait, I sense something ominous around you...
Oh gods, what is this?!
Are you trying to have your soul devoured by the Demon God?!
scripts.translation:
[希瓦·阿吉普]
等等，我感覺到你身上有股不祥的氣息...
天哪，這是什麼？！
你是想讓你的靈魂被惡魔之神吞噬嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Hiva Agip]
Give it to me, and I'll crystallize it for you.
And I want you to meet that Guardian lady at the Laphine camp.
She might know about this.
scripts.translation:
[希瓦·阿吉普]
把它交給我，我會幫你將其結晶化。
另外，我想讓你去拉芬營地見見那位被稱為“守衛”的女士。
她或許知道關於這件事的詳情。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
That purple lady called the Guardian said she'd go there soon.
You should find her.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
那位被稱為“守衛”的紫衣女士說她會很快過去。
你應該去找她。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
You're smart and capable. I don't have to explain why I'm telling you this, do I?
Don't worry. I've sent out an advance party.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
你很聰明，也很有能力。我不需要解釋為什麼要告訴你這些，對吧？
別擔心。我已經派出了先遣隊。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
Be joyous, comrade!
It won't be long before our perilous journey is over!
And you'll be the one to end it.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
高興起來吧，同志！
我們這段充滿危險的旅程即將結束！
而終結這一切的人，就是你。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
We've decided to call the newly discovered place the Temple of the Demon God.
Actually the first scout named it, and the name stuck.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我們決定將新發現的地方命名為“惡魔神殿”。
其實是最先到達的偵察兵起的名字，然後就沿用至今了。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I'd like to put you on a subjugation mission in the Temple of the Demon God.
This is not an order, but a request;
you decide to take the mission at your own risk.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我想指派你去執行平定惡魔神殿的任務。
這不是命令，而是請求；
是否接受任務，由你自己決定，風險自負。

scripts.text: I'll do it.
scripts.translation: 我會做的。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I understand
you don't want to risk your life for the world peace.
Enjoy living until the end of the world.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我理解
你不想為了世界和平而冒生命危險。
那就好好享受生活，直到世界末日吧。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
I knew I chose the right person for the job.
Loki said the Demon God hadn't fully recovered from
the damage received upon the break of his seal.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
我就知道選對了人。
洛基說，惡魔之神在封印解除時受到的傷害尚未完全恢復。

scripts.text:
[Hibba Agip]
He's still licking his wounds,
which gives us a perfect opportunity to get at him.
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[希巴·阿吉普]
他還在療傷，
這給了我們一個絕佳的機會去對付他。
祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Hiva Agip]
Take your reward.
See you again.
scripts.translation:
[希瓦·阿吉普]
請領取你的獎勵。
後會有期。

scripts.text:
[Hiva Agip]
I'm afraid once warped, dimensions can never be the same.
Could you go back to the Temple of the Demon God once more?
scripts.translation:
[希瓦·阿吉普]
恐怕一旦穿越，維度就再也回不到從前了。
你能再去一次惡魔神殿嗎？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Hiva Agip]
I understand.
You've done enough already.
I'll send someone else.
scripts.translation:
[希瓦·阿吉普]
我理解。
你已經做得夠多了。
我會派別人去。

scripts.text:
[Hiva Agip]
The Temple of the Demon God is stuck in a perpetual time loop,
just like all the other Dimensional Cracks.
scripts.translation:
[希瓦·阿吉普]
惡魔神殿陷入了永恆的時間迴圈，
就像其他所有的維度裂縫一樣。

scripts.text:
[Hiva Agip]
He tried desperately to escape from this world, but all to no avail.
That world of his is now filled with nothing but hellish memories that repeat themselves over and over.
scripts.translation:
[希瓦·阿吉普]
他拼命想要逃離這個世界，但都無濟於事。
他的世界如今只剩下地獄般的記憶，不斷重複上演。

scripts.text:
[Hiva Agip]
Good luck exploring the temple. If you see Morocc again, don't hesitate to kill the Demon God again.
He doesn't deserve commiseration.
Godspeed.
scripts.translation:
[希瓦·阿吉普]
祝你在神殿探索順利。如果你再次見到摩洛克，請毫不猶豫地再次擊殺惡魔之神。
他不值得同情。
一路順風。

scripts.text:
[Hiva Agip]
Let me know when you're ready.
Morocc is gone, yet his temple stands.
It might have something to do with the Dimensional Crack.
scripts.translation:
[希瓦·阿吉普]
準備好後告訴我。
摩洛克已經消失，但他的神殿依然矗立。
這可能與維度裂縫有關。

scripts.text:
[Hiva Agip]
Oh, don't worry. I'm not thinking to send you out there.
Hah hah hah!
scripts.translation:
[希瓦·阿吉普]
哦，別擔心。我沒打算派你去那裡。
哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Abidal]
Are you on the quest to subjugate the Temple of the Demon God?
Then please do me a favor.
Our scouts have reported on the presence of a Frost Spider and a Fire Wolf that have tasted the Frost of Genesis.
scripts.translation:
[阿比達爾]
你正在執行平定惡魔神殿的任務嗎？
那麼請幫個忙。
我們的偵察兵報告說，那裡有一隻冰霜幼蛛和一隻火狼，它們都嚐到了“創世之霜”的滋味。

scripts.text:
[Abidal]
They're just as evil as their master Morocc.
Please exterminate the Frost Spider and Fire Wolf.
scripts.translation:
[阿比達爾]
它們和它們的主人摩洛克一樣邪惡。
請消滅冰霜幼蛛和火狼。

scripts.text: Accept.
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Decline.
scripts.translation: 拒絕

scripts.text:
[Abidal]
Are you afraid you can't handle them?
I understand.
They're formidable enemies.
scripts.translation:
[阿比達爾]
你擔心自己無法對付它們嗎？
我理解。
它們確實是強大的敵人。

scripts.text:
[Abidal]
Thank you.
The Fire Spider is called Brinaranea; the Fire Wolf, Muspellskoll.
Please exterminate those creatures of the Demon God.
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[阿比達爾]
謝謝。
那隻火蜘蛛名叫巴利納拉雷亞，火狼名叫穆希貝斯寇。
請消滅這些惡魔神的造物。
祝你好運。

scripts.text:
[Abidal]
Did you come to help us subjugate the Demon God?
Please be careful; the environment of this place keeps changing without any warning.
scripts.translation:
[阿比達爾]
你是來幫助我們平定惡魔神的嗎？
請小心；這裡的環境會毫無徵兆地不斷變化。

scripts.text:
[Abidal]
According to my intel, the Demon God has several henchmen.
I'd like you to eliminate the biggest threat among them.
scripts.translation:
[阿比達爾]
根據我的情報，惡魔神有幾個手下。
我希望你能消除其中最大的威脅。

scripts.text:
[Abidal]
It won't be easy, but I have faith in you.
The future of Midgard rests on your shoulders.
scripts.translation:
[阿比達爾]
這不會容易，但我信任你。
米德加爾特的未來就託付給你了。

scripts.text:
[Abidal]
You did it!
I knew you would!
Congratulations!
scripts.translation:
[阿比達爾]
你做到了！
我就知道你可以的！
恭喜！

scripts.text:
[Abidal]
But I'm afraid this is not over yet.
I have this nagging sense of misgiving.
I'm sorry. Maybe I'm thinking irrationally.
scripts.translation:
[阿比達爾]
但恐怕事情還沒結束。
我心裡有種不安的感覺。
抱歉，也許我想多了。

scripts.text:
[Abidal]
I've prepared a small token of appreciation for you.
I'm sorry this is the best I can do.
Thank you for your hard work.
scripts.translation:
[阿比達爾]
我準備了一點小禮物以表謝意。
抱歉，這是我目前能做的最好的了。
感謝你的辛勤工作。

scripts.text:
[Abidal]
You did great. You should go rest.
scripts.translation:
[阿比達爾]
你做得很好。該去休息了。

scripts.text:
[Abidal]
Are you well rested?
You look like you are.
That's great because we're worried about the Temple of the Demon God. We can't seem to close it.
scripts.translation:
[阿比達爾]
你休息好了嗎？
看起來氣色不錯。
這很好，因為我們正擔心惡魔神殿的事。我們似乎無法將其關閉。

scripts.text:
[Abidal]
I might ask you again to exterminate Frost Spiders and Fire Wolves.
Why wouldn't the Temple of the Demon God disappear?
scripts.translation:
[阿比達爾]
我可能又要請你去消滅冰霜幼蛛和火狼了。
為什麼惡魔神殿不會消失呢？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
You.
(Shaking her head) You won't do.
You're too weak to fight these Demons.
Go back and train some more.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
你。
（搖頭）你不行。
你太弱了，無法對抗這些惡魔。
回去再訓練一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
Hey, well-met.
I need your help.
Some of those Demons pouring out of the Flaming Basin are a real pain in the neck.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
嘿，幸會。
我需要你的幫助。
從火焰盆地湧出的那些惡魔真是讓人頭疼。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
Morocc Reincarnations have invaded here just as well, and some of them are noticeably strong.
I want you to get rid of them.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
摩洛克的轉生體也入侵了這裡，其中一些明顯很強。
我想讓你把它們清除掉。

scripts.text: Why me?
scripts.translation: 為什麼是我？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
Um, this is unexpected.
I thought you came to protect the peace and prosperity of Midgard. Did you not?
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
嗯，這出乎我的意料。
我以為你是來保護米德加爾特和平與繁榮的。不是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
Maybe I gave you too much credit.
All right, I'll ask someone else.
I'm really disappointed in you.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
也許我對你評價太高了。
好吧，我去找別人。
我對你的表現很失望。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
You don't disappoint me.
Listen, in the center of the basin is a high hill.
In four directions from the center roams a strong Demon.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
你沒有讓我失望。
聽著，盆地中央有一座高丘。
從中心向四個方向，各有一隻強大的惡魔在遊蕩。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
They look just like those Reincarnations that attacked Morocc City,
but bigger and stronger.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
它們看起來就像那些襲擊摩洛克城的轉生體，
但更大、更強。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
For the smooth operation of the subjugation mission,
please ^4d4dffeliminate Distorted Morocc Reincarnation, Blazing Morocc Reincarnation, and Freezing Morocc Reincarnation.^000000
I'll be counting on you.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
為了平定任務的順利進行，
請^4d4dff消滅扭曲的摩洛克轉生體、燃燒的摩洛克轉生體和冰凍的摩洛克轉生體。^000000
拜託你了。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
Please ^4d4dffeliminate Distorted Morocc Reincarnation, Blazing Morocc Reincarnation, and Freezing Morocc Reincarnation.^000000
You can find them stationed in four directions from the center of the basin.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
請^4d4dff消滅扭曲的摩洛克轉生體、燃燒的摩洛克轉生體和冰凍的摩洛克轉生體。^000000
你可以在盆地中心周圍的四個方向找到它們。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
You really took out those strong Demons.
That should be enough to break the spirit of the rest.
Good job.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
你竟然真的消滅了那些強大的惡魔。
這應該足以擊潰其餘敵人計程車氣了。
幹得好。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
I hope you'll come back to help me again.
Let's go back home together, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
希望你能再次回來幫我。
我們一起回家吧，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
You.
Do you mean those giant reincarnations?
I've assigned some more adventurers to take care of them.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
你。
你是指那些巨大的轉生體嗎？
我已經指派了更多冒險者去處理它們。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
You should rest for the day. Come back to hunt tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
今天你應該好好休息了。明天再來狩獵吧。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Igrid]
It's almost time for a Demon hunt.
Aren't you excited? Because I am! Hah hah!
scripts.translation:
[指導員 伊格麗德]
馬上就要開始狩獵惡魔了。
你不興奮嗎？我可是很興奮呢！哈哈！

scripts.text:
You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest.
Please make some room in your inventory.
scripts.translation:
你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續任務。
請清理一些背包空間。

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
I'm Hesranta, commander of the Sappha army.
It's my honor to fight beside you Humans.
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
我是赫斯蘭塔，薩帕軍隊的指揮官。
能與你們人類並肩作戰，是我的榮幸。

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
I didn't expect to see you here!
... although a lot of things happened, I'm still waiting for you to complete the first thing I asked!
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
沒想到會在這裡見到你！
...雖然發生了很多事，但我還在等你完成我最初拜託你的那件事！

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
Long time, no see.
Do you remember me?
We had an important discussion together back in Diel.
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
好久不見。
你還記得我嗎？
我們之前在迪爾有過一次重要的談話。

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
Do you remember that we talked about Chesher?
He's a sensitive issue, so I can't talk to other Sapphas about him.
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
你還記得我們談論過切舍爾嗎？
這是個敏感話題，所以我不能和其他薩帕人談論他。

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
Do you remember that we talked about Chesher?
He's a sensitive issue, so I can't talk to other Sapphas about him.
And I was thinking...
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
你還記得我們談論過切舍爾嗎？
這是個敏感話題，所以我不能和其他薩帕人談論他。
而且我在想...

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
[Jeruth Hesranta]
Just hunt 1 ^4d4dffRampaging Box^000000 and bring me what you find inside it.
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
去狩獵1只 ^4d4dff狂暴寶箱^000000，並把裡面找到的東西帶給我。

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
I see that you've subjugated a Rampaging Box,
but my real objective was to check its contents.
^4d4dffPlease exterminate a box and bring me the item you've found from it.^000000
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
看來你已經制服了一隻狂暴寶箱，
但我真正的目的是檢查它裡面的內容。
^4d4dff請消滅一隻寶箱，並把從中找到的物品帶給我。^000000

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
I was right.
It's amazing how such an animate object can move on its own.
It must be enchanted, don't you think?
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
我猜對了。
這種有生命的物體竟然能自行移動，真是不可思議。
它一定是被施了魔法，你覺得呢？

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
[Jeruth Hesranta]
Rampaging Boxes themselves aren't threatening, but they're surrounded by dangerous monsters. Please be careful.
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
狂暴寶箱本身並不危險，但它們周圍環繞著危險的魔物。請小心。

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
It's amazing how those ore-filled boxes are moving on their own.
Maybe that's how the Demon God is recruiting his soldiers.
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
那些裝滿礦石的寶箱竟然能自行移動，真是不可思議。
也許這就是惡魔之神招募士兵的方式。

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
[Jeruth Hesranta]
Good job.
I can't thank you enough.
Let me take all the Bradium Boxes.
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
幹得好。
我感激不盡。
讓我收下所有的魔力之石寶箱。

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
Hah hah, we're not in a hurry at the moment.
I wonder if Chesher knows we're stealing back his Bradium Boxes.
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
哈哈，目前我們並不著急。
不知道切舍爾是否知道我們正在奪回他的魔力之石寶箱。

scripts.text: [Jeruth Hesranta]
scripts.translation: [傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
[Jeruth Hesranta]
Welcome back.
Are you ready for the day?
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
歡迎回來。
你準備好開始今天的工作了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
[Jeruth Hesranta]
It's time to collect Bradium Boxes.
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
是時候收集魔力之石寶箱了。

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
Please come back to help me!
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
請回來幫我！

scripts.text: Why are you here?
scripts.translation: 你為什麼在這裡？

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
I persuaded the Elders to let me bring an army here.
As you suspected, Ahat isn't a Sappha.
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
我說服了長老們，讓我帶一支軍隊來這裡。
正如你所料，阿哈特並不是薩帕。

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
Only I'm aware of that knowledge at the moment.
Everyone else has pretty much forgotten he ever existed.
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
目前只有我知曉這一真相。
其他人都幾乎忘記了他曾經存在過。

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
My undying suspicion about him kept me safe from Ahat's hypnosis.
He used the unspeakable talent to disappear.
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
我對他始終不渝的懷疑，讓我免受阿哈特催眠的影響。
他利用那不可言說的才能消失了。

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
After he disappeared, I persuaded the Elders that we must join the subjugation of the Demon God.
Other Sapphas were against me, for the safety of our kind,
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
在他消失後，我說服長老們，我們必須參與討伐惡魔神。
其他薩帕為了種族的安危而反對我，

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
but it's in our nature to help our friends at all costs.
So I've brought our bravest Gartens to the battlefield.
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
但我們的天性就是不惜一切代價幫助朋友。
所以我帶了我們最勇敢的加滕斯戰士來到戰場。

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
Long story short,
you no longer have to work for Ahat.
If you need the Contribution Certificate, do me a favor later and I'll give you one.
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
長話短說，
你不再需要為阿哈特工作了。
如果你需要貢獻證書，之後幫我個忙，我就給你一張。

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
You know Chesher, don't you?
When it comes to him,
I can't trust anyone else.
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
你認識切舍爾，對吧？
關於他的事，
我誰都不信，只信你。

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
I want to collect information about him first before I proceed with my plan.
Please stay safe until I talk to you again.
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
在實施計劃之前，我想先收集一些關於他的情報。
請保持安全，等我下次再聯絡你。

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
But... it does not seem to please you,
go back and train some more.
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
但是...看來這並不合你意，
回去再訓練一下吧。

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
Maybe you could help me confirm my suspicion.
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
也許你能幫我證實我的懷疑。

scripts.text: What suspicion?
scripts.translation: 什麼懷疑？

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
There are some things that don't seem to belong to this Flaming Basin.
They're boxes of some kind.
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
這裡有些東西看起來不屬於這個火焰盆地。
它們是某種箱子。

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
Animated by the Demon God's evil energy, those boxes are running amok about the basin.
Now I'm concerned...
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
被惡魔神的邪惡能量驅動，這些箱子在盆地中四處亂竄。
我現在很擔心...

scripts.text: You're concerned?
scripts.translation: 你擔心什麼？

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
They're the spitting images of Bradium Boxes in Dicastes.
Could you exterminate them and help me determine their identity?
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
它們和迪卡特斯那裡的魔力之石寶箱一模一樣。
你能消滅它們，幫我確認它們的身份嗎？

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
They really could be the Bradium Boxes that Chesher stole from Dicastes.
If so, I can use the boxes to replenish my army.
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
它們很可能就是切舍爾從迪卡特斯偷走的魔力之石寶箱。
如果是這樣，我可以用這些箱子來補充我的軍隊。

scripts.text: And retrieve the stolen Bradiums as well.
scripts.translation: 順便取回被偷走的魔力之石。

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
Correct. My army isn't getting much support, since this expedition has been solely my idea.
It's just wishful thinking; we won't know until we have the boxes.
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
沒錯。由於這次遠征完全是我的主意，我的軍隊並沒有得到多少支援。
這只是我的願望；在拿到箱子之前，我們無從得知。

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
For now please hunt one box and let me know what you find from it.
I'll be waiting.
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
現在請先獵殺一個箱子，告訴我你從中發現了什麼。
我會等著。

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
This confirms my suspicion:
those boxes in the Flaming Basin are Bradium Boxes from El Dicastes.
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
這證實了我的猜測：
那些在烈焰盆地的箱子，正是來自迪卡特斯的魔力之石寶箱。

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
I don't want to impose on your kindness, but I hope you'll continue to hunt these boxes.
You're the only one I can trust with this, at least for now.
Gartens are brave, but they'll want to understand why Bradium Boxes are found in this place.
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
我不想麻煩你，但我希望你能繼續獵殺這些箱子。
至少目前，你是唯一能讓我信任的人。
加滕斯們雖然勇敢，但他們也會想知道為什麼魔力之石寶箱會出現在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
Then I'll have to tell them everything,
starting with Ahat, and that most Sapphas have forgotten about him will make things really complicated.
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
那我只能把一切都告訴他們了，
從阿哈特開始。大多數薩帕斯已經忘記了他，這會讓事情變得非常複雜。

scripts.text: When do I start?
scripts.translation: 我什麼時候開始？

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
How about now?
^4d4dffPlease hunt those Rampaging Boxes and collect 10 Bradium Boxes.^000000
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
現在如何？
^4d4dff請獵殺那些狂暴的箱子，並收集10個魔力之石寶箱。^000000

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
Happy hunting!
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
I can feel other people's eyes on us. Hah hah.
See you again.
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
我能感覺到其他人的目光在我們身上。哈哈。
再見。

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
What should I feed the poor cat later?
Oh, keep up the good work collecting Bradium Boxes.
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
之後我該給那隻可憐的貓喂點什麼好呢？
哦，繼續收集魔力之石寶箱吧。

scripts.text: I'll get on with it.
scripts.translation: 我會繼續的。

scripts.text: I'll come back later.
scripts.translation: 我稍後再來。

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
No problem.
Come back whenever you can.
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
沒問題。
隨時回來。

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
I'm sorry that
I can't stop asking you for favors.
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
抱歉，
我不得不一直麻煩你。

scripts.text:
[Jeruth Hesranta]
That's the spirit!
hunt Rampaging Boxes and collect Bradiums.
scripts.translation:
[傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔]
好樣的！
去獵殺狂暴的箱子，收集魔力之石吧。

scripts.text:
[Dophe]
A Human, I see.
Looking at you, I can't help but muse on our situation.
You and I are having conversation.
scripts.translation:
[多菲]
原來是個人類。
看著你，我不禁感嘆我們的處境。
你和我正在對話。

scripts.text:
[Dophe]
This so-called Dimensional Crack, where the Demon God has taken up residence, falls into Bifrost's jurisdiction.
scripts.translation:
[多菲]
這個所謂的次元裂縫，惡魔神居住的地方，屬於雙層牛肉堡的管轄範圍。

scripts.text:
[Dophe]
He and us are like two sides of the coin, or above and below the waterline.
scripts.translation:
[多菲]
他和我們就像硬幣的兩面，或者水面的上下。

scripts.text:
[Dophe]
He and us aren't exactly running parallel to each other, but maybe standing in a universe parallel to each other's.
scripts.translation:
[多菲]
他和我們並不是完全平行的，也許是在彼此平行的宇宙中站立著。

scripts.text:
[Dophe]
...

[Dophe]
My point is:
he could be under our nose, and we're unable to see him.
If his lair is located somewhere in Bifrost's territory,
scripts.translation:
[多菲]
我的意思是：
他可能就在我們眼皮底下，而我們看不見他。
如果他的巢穴位於雙層牛肉堡的領土內，

scripts.text:
[Dophe]
the only possible scenario for us is
obliteration.
scripts.translation:
[多菲]
對我們來說，唯一可能的結局就是
毀滅。

scripts.text:
[Konpana]
This place is nothing like I've imagined.
No grassy field or forest, really?
scripts.translation:
[孔帕納]
這裡和我想像的不一樣。
沒有草地或森林，真的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Makia]
This place is overrun with strange creatures.
Everywhere is burning with fire, yet the air isn't suffocating.
Amazing.
scripts.translation:
[瑪基婭]
這裡到處都是奇怪的生物。
到處都在燃燒，但空氣並不令人窒息。
真是不可思議。

scripts.text:
[Commander Laphine]
We're in the process of regrouping for the upcoming battle.
Please don't bother us.
scripts.translation:
[拉菲尼指揮官]
我們正在為即將到來的戰鬥重新集結。
請不要打擾我們。

scripts.text:
[Ryoson]
Of course I'm nervous. You don't have to ask me that.
Why the Administrative Officer put me in charge of the knights is beyond me.
scripts.translation:
[良孫]
我當然很緊張，不用問我也知道。
行政官為什麼讓我負責騎士們，真是令人費解。

scripts.text:
[Ryoson]
They're not knights-in-training, or even apprentice knights. They're freaking Rune Knights.
Ah, I'm too inexperienced and powerless to do anything with them.
scripts.translation:
[良孫]
他們不是見習騎士，甚至不是學徒騎士。他們是盧恩騎士。
唉，我太缺乏經驗，對他們無能為力。

scripts.text:
[Ryoson]
At least my safety is guaranteed so long as the three knights are with me.
I hope.
scripts.translation:
[良孫]
只要那三位騎士在我身邊，至少我的安全是有保障的。
希望如此。

scripts.text:
[Hugh]
We're here at last.
At first, I couldn't believe all those rumors about the Demon God's hideout and stronghold.
scripts.translation:
[休]
我們終於到了。
起初，我簡直不敢相信關於魔王巢穴和據點的那些傳聞。

scripts.text:
[Hugh]
As things stand, I have no hope of going back to the mainland any time soon.
scripts.translation:
[休]
就目前的情況來看，我短時間內無法回到大陸。

scripts.text:
[Hugh]
Gosh, I'm tired of those guys.
I'd better find the Demon God quickly.
scripts.translation:
[休]
天哪，我受夠了那些人。
我得快點找到魔王。

scripts.text:
[Hugh]
Have I thought about losing?
I have, but I try not to.
I'll never going to win if I let myself believe I'll lose.
scripts.translation:
[休]
我有沒有想過失敗？
想過，但我儘量不去想。
如果我讓自己相信會輸，就永遠贏不了了。

scripts.text:
[Hugh]
We Schwarzwaldians are born to win.
scripts.translation:
[休]
我們施瓦茨瓦爾德人天生就是為了勝利而生的。

scripts.text:
[Henjinne]
This place is much more exciting than I imagined!
Where's the Demon God anyway?
scripts.translation:
[亨金娜]
這裡比我想像的還要刺激！
魔王到底在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Henjinne]
Neither hide nor hair of him is to be seen.
Mwah hah hah!
scripts.translation:
[亨金娜]
連他的影子都看不見。
哇哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Jakken]
When I volunteered for the Ash-Bakum Expedition, I knew this day would come.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 雅肯]
當我報名參加阿什-巴庫姆遠征隊時，我就知道這一天會到來。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Jakken]
I'm ready.
I'm going to fight to the death for the peace of the Midgard Continent.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 雅肯]
我準備好了。
我將為米德加爾特的和平戰鬥到最後一刻。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Jakken]
But I'm nervous all the same.
I really need to work on my emotional control. I don't want to scare anyone else.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 雅肯]
但我還是很緊張。
我真的需要加強情緒控制。我不想嚇到別人。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Assassin]
A new mission will be announced soon.
Our objective is to locate the Demon God.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊刺客]
新的任務即將釋出。
我們的目標是找到魔王。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Assassin]
Let me check the intel our predecessors have left for us.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊刺客]
讓我檢查一下前輩們留給我們的情報。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Assassin]
...
It's rude to eavesdrop on others, even if they're your colleagues.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊刺客]
...
偷聽別人說話是不禮貌的，即使是同事。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Assassin]
This area... Well,
I'll check it out later.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊刺客]
這個區域... 嗯，
我稍後再來看看。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Assassin]
Sigh.
Can't you see we're having a meeting? Please leave.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊刺客]
唉。
你看不到我們在開會嗎？請離開。

scripts.text:
[Expedition Assassin]
... 
Well, I'm at the bottom of the food chain.
I just watch what my seniors do.
That's all.
scripts.translation:
[遠征隊刺客]
...
嗯，我在食物鏈的最底端。
我只能看著前輩們怎麼做。
就這樣。

scripts.text:
[Vehanus]
You came here, too.
You can communicate with me without the ring, I see.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
你也來了。
看來不用戒指也能和我溝通了。

scripts.text:
[Vehanus]
Now I wonder how far Bifrost's grace reaches.
Maybe I should use this opportunity to get to know the Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
真想知道雙層牛肉堡的恩澤能延伸到多遠。
也許我該利用這個機會，多瞭解一下拉菲涅斯。

scripts.text:
[Vehanus]
I admire Hesranta's bravery.
He's come to the battlefield, willing to ally with our enemy Laphines.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
我很欽佩赫斯蘭塔的勇氣。
他來到戰場，願意與我們的敵人拉菲涅斯結盟。

scripts.text:
[Vehanus]
I really hope we won't have to fight Laphines in here.
scripts.translation:
[維漢努斯]
我真希望我們不必在這裡與拉菲涅斯交戰。

scripts.text:
[Tiera]
The Jeruths and Nits in Dicastes Diel may have acquiesced Hesranta's plea,
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃拉]
迪卡斯提斯的傑魯斯和尼茨可能已經默許了赫斯蘭塔的請求，

scripts.text:
[Tiera]
but I'm completely with him on this.
Our enemies are our friends in the face of a common enemy: Demon God.
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃拉]
但我完全支援他。
面對共同的敵人——魔王，我們的敵人就是朋友。

scripts.text:
[Tiera]
We can be cowards and let others fight the fight for us, sure,
but what if they lose? We'll go down with them, and that'll be on us.
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃拉]
我們可以當懦夫，讓別人替我們戰鬥，
但如果他們輸了呢？我們會跟著一起完蛋，那責任就在我們身上。

scripts.text:
[Tiera]
The same goes for you, Humans.
We fight this fight to win.
scripts.translation:
[蒂埃拉]
你們人類也是一樣。
我們戰鬥是為了勝利。

scripts.text:
[Avaranche]
My unit consists of the best of the best Gartens.
Human warrior,
I've waited for this day to fight beside you.
scripts.translation:
[阿瓦蘭奇]
我的部隊由最優秀的加爾滕組成。
人類戰士，
我等待與你並肩作戰的日子很久了。

scripts.text:
[Avaranche]
I swear on my life that I won't stop fighting until the Demon God is defeated!
scripts.translation:
[阿瓦蘭奇]
我以生命起誓，在魔王被擊敗之前，我不會停止戰鬥！

scripts.text:
[Dicastes Garten]
When can we fight?
When?
scripts.translation:
[迪卡斯提斯的 加爾滕]
我們什麼時候能開戰？
什麼時候？

scripts.text:
[Dicastes Garten]
I can't believe I have to fight alongside those accursed Laphines.
I still remember what they did to us in the last battle.
scripts.translation:
[迪卡斯提斯的 加爾滕]
我無法相信我要和那些該死的拉菲涅斯並肩作戰。
我還記得上一場戰鬥中他們對我們做的事。

scripts.text:
[Dicastes Garten]
My duty is to protect Jeruth Hesranta.
You'd better step back,
or I'll consider you my enemy.
scripts.translation:
[迪卡斯提斯的 加爾滕]
我的職責是保護傑魯斯·赫斯蘭塔。
你最好退後，
否則我會把你視為敵人。

scripts.text: - There is a pile of dirty rags. -
scripts.translation: - 有一堆髒布。 -

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text: - There is a pile of dirty rags. -
scripts.translation: - 有一堆髒布。 -

scripts.text: Leave it.
scripts.translation: 離開

scripts.text: Remove it.
scripts.translation: 移除它

scripts.text: - You left the pile of dirty rags where it is. -
scripts.translation: - 你把那堆髒布留在了原地。 -

scripts.text: - A moan is heard underneath the pile of rags. -
scripts.translation: - 從布堆下面傳來呻吟聲。 -

scripts.text: Run.
scripts.translation: 執行

scripts.text: Shake the rags.
scripts.translation: 搖晃布堆

scripts.text: - Startled, you ran. -
scripts.translation: - 你嚇了一跳，轉身就跑。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey,
wake up!

[{0}]
Are you all right?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你沒事吧？

scripts.text:
[???]
Ugh...
I n-need food...
I could even eat ^0000FFMonster's Feed^000000. Please...
scripts.translation:
[???]
呃...
我...我需要食物...
我甚至能吃^0000FF魔物飼料^000000。拜託了...

scripts.text:
- Again he lost consciousness, exhausted just from talking.
You should feed him ^0000FFMonster's Feed^000000. -
scripts.translation:
- 他又失去了意識，光是說話就精疲力竭了。
你應該給他^0000FF魔物飼料^000000。 -

scripts.text:

[???]

Yuck!

[???]
*Chomp Chomp*
*Barf*
scripts.translation:

*嘔吐*

你沒事吧？

scripts.translation:

*乾嘔*

scripts.text:
[???]
I thought I was going to die. I'm lucky to be alive.
scripts.translation:
[???]
我以為我要死了。能活著真是幸運。

scripts.text:
[???]
I've been having nothing but bad luck lately.
scripts.translation:
[???]
我最近運氣一直很差。

scripts.text:
[???]
I got sucked into some strange place, separated from the rest of my party. The place I arrived was terrible. There was no sign of Human habitation.
scripts.translation:
[???]
我被捲入了某個奇怪的地方，與隊伍的其他人走散了。我到達的地方很糟糕。那裡沒有任何人類居住的痕跡。

scripts.text:
[???]
It's a miracle that I'm here.
scripts.translation:
[???]
我能在這裡真是個奇蹟。

scripts.text:
[???]
I lucked out.
Still alive.
Hah hah hah!
scripts.translation:
[???]
我運氣不錯。
還活著。
哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[???]
Oh!
Where are my manners? I forgot to thank you properly.
scripts.translation:
[???]
哦！
我的禮儀呢？我忘了好好感謝你了。

scripts.text:
[???]
Thank you
for feeding me, though the feed tasted horrible.
scripts.translation:
[???]
謝謝你餵我吃東西，雖然飼料的味道很糟糕。

scripts.text:
[???]
I'm glad I didn't die on the street. The world is still a beautiful place.
I'm moved.
scripts.translation:
[???]
很高興我沒有死在街頭。世界依然是一個美麗的地方。
我很感動。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
My name is ^0000FFTamarin^000000.
I'm an adventurer, and no, this isn't my preferred attire.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
我叫^0000FF塔馬林^000000。
我是一名冒險者，不，這不是我平時的穿著。

scripts.text: Introduce yourself.
scripts.translation: 自我介紹

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
{0}, huh? That's a good name.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
{0}，是嗎？真是個好名字。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Ah,
I'd better do something before people start asking if I'm homeless.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
啊，
我得做點什麼，不然別人會以為我是流浪漢的。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Do you know a place where I can wash myself?
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
你知道哪裡可以洗澡嗎？

scripts.text: Tell him the place.
scripts.translation: 告訴他地點

scripts.text: Say you don't know.
scripts.translation: 表示不知道

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Water is scarce in the desert, huh?
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
沙漠裡水很稀缺，是嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Ah,
do you mean the ^0000FFoasis near the northwestern sphinx^000000?
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
啊，
你是指^0000FF西北斯芬克斯附近的綠洲^000000嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I've been in Morocc, but this is my first time inside the village.
I remember hearing that the place holds special water.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
我雖然去過摩洛哥，但這是第一次進入村莊。
我記得聽說那裡有特別的水。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I feel excited to wash myself with the special water!
I'm going to the oasis now. Could you wait for me?
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
能用特別的水洗澡，我有點興奮！
我現在就去綠洲。你能等我一下嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
It'll take a while before I feel strong again, but at least I can walk on my own.
Hah hah hah!
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
要恢復體力還需要一段時間，但至少我能自己走路了。
哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text: Watch him.
scripts.translation: 看著他

scripts.text: Accompany him.
scripts.translation: 陪他一起

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
(Braces himself and inhales.)
Wait, wait.
I can stand up on my own.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
（調整姿勢並深呼吸。）
等等，等等。
我可以自己站起來。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Wait, wait!
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
等等，等等！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
How kind of you!
The world is still an okay place to live.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
你真好！
這個世界還是值得生活的。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Then, let's go to the ^0000FFoasis near the northwestern sphinx^000000.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
那麼，我們去^0000FF西北斯芬克斯附近的綠洲^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
How kind of you!
The world is still an okay place to live.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
你真好！
這個世界還是值得生活的。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Then, let's go to the ^0000FFoasis near the northwestern sphinx^000000.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
那麼，我們去^0000FF西北斯芬克斯附近的綠洲^000000吧。

scripts.text: - There is a pile of dirty rags. -
scripts.translation: - 有一堆髒布。 -

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Pah!
This feels great!
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
噗！
感覺真不錯！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
The water feels too warm for my liking, but beggars can't be choosers.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
水對我來說有點太熱了，但乞丐不能挑三揀四。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
You saved me from starvation, and took me to this great place. I must have been a great person in the past life
to deserve such kindness.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
你救了我免於餓死，還帶我來到這麼棒的地方。
我上輩子一定是個好人，才配得上這份善意。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I want to repay you, fellow adventurer.
I lost all my belongings when I fell into that strange hole and got separated from my party,
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
我想報答你，冒險者。
我掉進那個奇怪的洞後，和隊伍走散了，所有東西都丟了，

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
but at least I can tell you an ^0000FFinteresting story^000000.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
但至少我可以給你講一個^0000FF有趣的故事^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
It's about the strange place I've been to.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
那是關於我去過的一個奇怪地方的故事。

scripts.text: Not interested.
scripts.translation: 不感興趣

scripts.text: I'm listening.
scripts.translation: 我在聽。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
All right, then.
I thought you were serious about adventuring.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
好吧。
我還以為你是認真的要當冒險者呢。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Then
do you want your Monster's Feed back?
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
那麼，
你要回你的魔物飼料嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
*Retch*
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
*乾嘔*

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I knew you'd be interested!
Nothing piques adventurers' interest like the story of a strange place, right?
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
我就知道你會感興趣！
沒有什麼比奇怪地方的故事更能勾起冒險者的興趣了，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Ahem.
The story begins with my journey to the ^0000FFOther World^000000, the latest hot spot for adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
咳。
故事從我前往^0000FF異世界^000000的旅程開始，那是冒險者們最新的熱門地點。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Adventurer Tamarin and his party went on a journey to the land of the unknown, Other World.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
冒險者塔馬林和他的隊伍踏上了前往未知之地——異世界的旅程。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Their journey was perilous, but they bravely moved forward.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
旅途充滿危險，但他們勇敢地向前邁進。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Oh,
why am I speaking in the third-person perspective?
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
啊，
我為什麼在用第三人稱？

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
My original inspiration was Bard, but then I became a Hunter because my friends thought that suited me better.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
我最初的靈感是詩人，但後來因為朋友覺得獵人更適合我，我就轉職成了獵人。

scripts.text: Ask him to be more straightforward.
scripts.translation: 讓他說得更直白些

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Yes.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
是的。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
A while ago, my friends and I decided to explore the Other World together.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
不久前，我和朋友們決定一起去探索異世界。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Since it'd be our first visit to the Other World, we wanted to go to a more popular spot, but one of us wouldn't have it--he was so excited that he started acting out of control.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
因為那是我們第一次去異世界，我們想去個更熱門的地方，但其中一個人不同意——他太興奮了，開始失控地行動。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
When I came back to my senses, I was alone in a strange place.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
等我回過神來，我已經獨自身處一個奇怪的地方。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
The ^0000FFland was burning with perpetual flames^000000 that weren't too hot to touch, and ^0000FFstrange-looking plants and insects^000000 were crawling all over the place.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
^0000FF大地燃燒著永恆的火焰^000000，雖然摸起來不太燙，但到處都是^0000FF奇形怪狀的植物和昆蟲^000000在爬行。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
At first I yelled for help and moved around hoping to find others, but all to no avail.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
起初我大聲呼救，四處走動希望能找到其他人，但都無濟於事。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
After a few days of having nothing to eat, I started to eat anything I saw off the ground, and I had the worst diarrhea ever.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
餓了幾天後，我開始吃地上看到的一切東西，結果拉了這輩子最慘的一回。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I didn't know how many days had passed before I saw a group of some entities that I thought were men at a glance.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
不知過了多少天，我看到了一群生物，乍一看像是人類。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
But ^0000FFthey looked too strange to pass as human^000000.
I couldn't talk to them, so I just jumped into the Crack that they came through.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
但^0000FF他們看起來太奇怪了，根本不像人^000000。
我沒法和他們交流，於是直接跳進了他們出現的那個裂縫裡。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
My knees gave way and I rolled on my side. When I looked around, I was back at the ^0000FFDimensional Crack^000000 where my friends and I first arrived.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
我的膝蓋一軟，側身滾了出去。環顧四周，我發現自己回到了我和朋友們最初到達的^0000FF次元裂縫^000000處。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I came out through the ^0000FFMorocc Dimensional Teleporter^000000 and used every ounce of my energy to get to Morocc.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
我從^0000FF莫洛奇次元傳送門^000000出來，拼盡全力趕到了莫洛奇。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Sigh...
I wonder if my friends are safe.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
唉...
不知道朋友們是否平安。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I should seek them out,
but first I want to go back to that strange place when I get my full strength back. Not many people have a chance to see such a special place, you know.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
我應該去找他們，但首先，等體力完全恢復後，我想再回那個奇怪的地方看看。畢竟，能親眼看到那種特別地方的人可不多啊。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Fortunately for me, with the ^0000FFMorocc restoration work^000000 underway, I shouldn't have a problem making money through some part-time jobs.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
幸運的是，^0000FF莫洛奇的修復工作^000000正在進行中，我找些零工賺點錢應該不成問題。

scripts.text: Tell him have safe travel.
scripts.translation: 祝他旅途平安

scripts.text: Tell him you want to tag along.
scripts.translation: 表示想同行

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I will.
Thank you for saving me.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
我會的。
謝謝你救了我。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
This is the beauty of adventuring:
making new friends!
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
這就是冒險的魅力：
結識新朋友！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I'll be in Morocc for a while, making some money and getting ready for another adventure. I hope I can see you again before I leave.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
我會在莫洛奇待一段時間，賺點錢並準備下一次冒險。希望在我離開前還能再見到你。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
!!
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
!!

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Do you mean it?
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
你是認真的嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
By the gods I'm a lucky bastard!
*Sob*
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
天哪，我真是走運！
*抽泣*

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Then meet me at the ^0000FFDimensional Crack^000000. I need to replenish myself first.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
那我們在^0000FF次元裂縫^000000碰面吧。我得先補充一下體力。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
It may take a while for me to get everything packed, so get your other business done in the meantime.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
收拾東西可能需要點時間，你趁這段時間去處理其他事務吧。

scripts.text:

那我們在^0000FF次元裂縫^000000碰面吧。我得先補充一下體力。

scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
收拾東西可能需要點時間，你趁這段時間去處理其他事務吧。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Pah!
This feels great!
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
噗！
感覺真不錯！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
{0}, over here!
You're early.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
{0}，這邊！
你來得挺早啊。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
(Glancing around surreptitiously)
I hope no one's watching us.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
（偷偷環顧四周）
希望沒人注意到我們。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I've hidden the opening to that place: I didn't want anyone to get there before me.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
我已經把那個地方的入口藏起來了，不想讓任何人搶在我之前到達那裡。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
At that time, I was too distracted to remember where the opening was, but I think it's definitely ^0000FFsomewhere on the 2nd floor^000000.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
當時我太分心了，沒記住入口的具體位置，但我確信它就在^0000FF二樓的某個地方^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Meet me in front of the ^0000FFHidden Crack^000000. Make sure no one follows you there.
I've ^0000FFcovered the opening with dirt^000000. I hope no one dug it open.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
在^0000FF隱藏裂縫^000000前等我。確保沒有人跟蹤你。
我已經^0000FF用泥土封住了入口^000000。希望沒人把它挖開了。

scripts.translation:

我已經把那個地方的入口藏起來了，不想讓任何人搶在我之前到達那裡。

At that time, I was too distracted to remember where the opening was, but I think it's definitely ^0000FFsomewhere on the 2nd floor^000000.
scripts.translation:

當時我太分心了，沒記住入口的具體位置，但我確信它就在^0000FF二樓的某個地方^000000。

Meet me in front of the ^0000FFHidden Crack^000000. Make sure no one follows you there.
I've ^0000FFcovered the opening with dirt^000000. I hope no one dug it open.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
在^0000FF隱藏裂縫^000000前等我。確保沒有人跟蹤你。
我已經^0000FF用泥土封住了入口^000000。希望沒人把它挖開了。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Hm, my mark had better stay where I left it.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
嗯，希望我留下的標記還在那裡。

scripts.text: - A mound of sand stands awkwardly, looking out of place. -
scripts.translation: - 一堆沙子突兀地立在那裡，顯得格格不入。 -

scripts.translation: - 一堆沙子突兀地立在那裡，顯得格格不入。 -

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Whew!
I'm glad you've found me.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
呼！
很高興你找到我了。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Let me clear the dirt...
Be mindful of the opening. It's quite narrow.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
讓我把泥土清理一下...
注意入口，它很窄。

scripts.translation: 進入

scripts.text:

Aren't you going in?
scripts.translation:

你不進去嗎？

scripts.translation: - 通道僅容一人通過。 -

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Whoa!
I didn't expect to see so many people.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
哇！
沒想到會有這麼多人。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I'm disappointed that I'm not the first one to discover the place, and am glad that I'm not alone in this dismal place.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
我很失望自己不是第一個發現這裡的人，但也很慶幸在這個淒涼的地方不是孤身一人。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I see more of those entities that look sort of like men.
This place might be much more than I thought it was!
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
我看到更多那些看起來有點像人的實體。
這個地方可能比我想像的還要複雜！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Look!
Walking trees!
Grrr-!
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
看！
會走的樹！
格嚕嚕-！

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
HEY!
What the hell do you think you're doing?!
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
嘿！
你們在幹什麼鬼事？！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Look!
Walking trees!
Grrr-!
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
看！
會走的樹！
格嚕嚕-！

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
HEY!
What the hell do you think you're doing?!
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
嘿！
你們在幹什麼鬼事？！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
They might kick us out if they know we sneaked in.
Let's do what they ask for now, yeah?
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
如果他們知道我們是偷偷進來的，可能會把我們趕出去。
現在先照他們說的做，好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Collecting the plant specimens doesn't sound too difficult. We can split them between us.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
收集植物標本聽起來不難。我們可以分工合作。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
^0000FFWhen you collect 25 Sonia stems, meet me by the big rock in the center of this place^000000.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
^0000FF當你收集到25根索妮雅莖時，到這個地方的中央大岩石旁找我^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Ooh! (Wincing)
You don't have enough stems.
Get more and take them to Barget.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
噢！（皺眉）
你的莖不夠。
多收集一些，然後交給巴爾蓋特。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Let's report to Barget first.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
我們先去跟巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克彙報吧。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Come on,
hurry over to ^0000FFInstructor Rugen^000000!
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
快一點，
趕緊去找^0000FF指導員 魯根^000000！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Thank the gods, who knew that thing I ate out of hunger would save me?
Let's report to Barget.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
謝天謝地，誰能想到我餓得吃下的那個東西能救我一命呢？
我們先去跟巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克彙報吧。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Arrgh!
{0} Get in the cave before everyone else explores it!
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
啊！
{0} 趕在其他人探索之前先進入洞穴！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Ugh...
I was the first to come to this place!
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
真是的...
明明是我第一個來到這裡的！

scripts.text: - You are carrying too many items to proceed with the quest. -
scripts.translation: - 你攜帶的物品過多，無法繼續任務。 -

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
Ugh, I'm exhausted.
I understand the urgency, but that doesn't mean I like being bossed around.
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
唉，我累死了。
我理解事情的緊迫性，但這不代表我喜歡被人指手畫腳。

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
You've ruined my precious samples!
I've asked people of your ilk to steer clear of my work zone. Didn't your superiors tell you that?
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
你們弄壞了我珍貴的樣本！
我已經要求你們這類人遠離我的工作區域了。你們的上司沒有告訴你們嗎？

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
I haven't even finished the research at the camp, and they dragged me away for yet another burdening project.
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
我在營地的研究還沒做完，他們又把我拉去處理另一個麻煩的專案。

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
I demand an assistant!
Enough with that budget problem!
Argh!
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
我需要一個助手！
別再跟我提預算問題了！
啊！

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
...
...
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
...
...

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
All right.
You two over there!
You must have too much time on your hands, loitering about aimlessly. Make yourself useful and help me collect samples.
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
好吧。
那邊那兩個人！
你們看起來閒得發慌，到處閒逛。既然這樣，就幫我把樣本收集起來吧。

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
You've ruined my existing samples, after all.
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
畢竟，是你們弄壞了我現有的樣本。

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
First, I want to collect animal specimens.
It's not uncommon to see mutant animals around here. Recently, one of them was confirmed as a ^0000FFcompletely new species^000000.
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
首先，我要收集動物標本。
在這裡看到變異動物並不罕見。最近，其中一種被確認為^0000FF全新的物種^000000。

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
^0000FFThis new species of insect is called the Firebugs because they're surrounded by flames and live in fire pits like that over there^000000.
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
^0000FF這種新的昆蟲物種被稱為火蟲，因為它們被火焰包圍，並生活在像那邊那樣的火坑中^000000。

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
Firebugs that crawl out of their pits die soon after.
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
從火坑裡爬出來的火蟲很快就會死去。

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
Please investigate ^0000FF20 fire pits and collect 50 Burning Insect Shells from Firebugs^000000.
Be careful not to burn yourself in the process.
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
請調查^0000FF20個火坑，並從火蟲身上收集50個燃燒昆蟲殼^000000。
過程中小心別被燒傷。

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
Oh,
well done!
You finished your task more quickly than I anticipated.
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
哦，
幹得好！
你們完成任務的速度比我預想的要快。

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
Ouch, HOT!
*Huffing Puffing*
Let me bottle them before they get cold, and send them to the lab.
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
哎喲，好燙！
*氣喘吁吁*
讓我把它們裝進瓶子裡，趁它們還沒冷卻，送去實驗室。

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
Now, it's time for plant specimens.
Our target plant is called Sonia, a very primitive type of plant.
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
現在，該收集植物標本了。
我們的目標植物叫索妮雅，是一種非常原始的植物型別。

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
At a glance, Sonias look like plastic tubes, but their structure is very minimal.
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
乍一看，索妮雅像塑膠管，但它們的結構非常原始。

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
They're not difficult to gather. Please ^0000FFpick 50 Sonias and bring me 50 stems^000000.
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
採集起來並不困難。請^0000FF採集50株索妮雅，並帶給我50根莖^000000。

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
Sonia specimens are the last of my specimen collection. If you happen to ^0000FFsee peculiar Sonias^000000, please don't hesitate to let me know.
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
索妮雅標本是我標本收藏的最後一部分。如果你恰好^0000FF看到奇怪的索妮雅^000000，請毫不猶豫地告訴我。

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
Try not to stray too far away from the base. It's too dangerous out there.
Come back safely.
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
儘量不要離基地太遠。外面太危險了。
請安全回來。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Hm...
{0}, wait!

[Barget Tiblack]
How are you doing with collecting Sonias?
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
你採集索妮雅的情況如何？

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
Ah,
welcome back!
I forgot to tell you ^0000FFnot to go near the rock in the center of this place^000000.
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
啊，
歡迎回來！
我忘了告訴你^0000FF不要靠近這個地方中央的岩石^000000。

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
When I realized my mistake, I called a rescue party, so worried for your safety. I'm glad you're back unscathed.
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
當我意識到自己的疏忽時，我立刻召集了救援隊，非常擔心你的安全。很高興你毫髮無傷地回來了。

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
I apologize for being a total jerk.
I was stressed out about my heavy workload.
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
抱歉我像個徹頭徹尾的混蛋。
我因為繁重的工作壓力太大。

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
I still have so many things to do... Sigh...
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
我還有很多事情要做... 唉...

scripts.text: Tell her about the central rock.
scripts.translation: 告訴她關於中央岩石的事。

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
Say WHAT?!
You went there?!
And you came back unscathed? How?
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
你說什麼？！
你去了那裡？！
而且你毫髮無傷地回來了？怎麼做到的？

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
Everyone else who went there ^0000FFfell into a coma due to the noxious gas released from the rock^000000.
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
其他去了那裡的人^0000FF都因岩石釋放的廢氣而陷入昏迷^000000。

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
What did you do?
This is a great discovery!
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
你做了什麼？
這是一個偉大的發現！

scripts.text: Relay what happened.
scripts.translation: 轉述發生的事情。

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
You ate a Sonia stem.
Okay, I've known the stem is nontoxic, but I haven't finished its substance research yet. Did you experience any side effect?
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
你吃了一根索妮雅的莖。
好吧，我知道莖是無毒的，但我還沒完成對其成分的研究。你有任何副作用嗎？

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
Wow!
This really is a great discovery!
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
哇！
這真的是一個偉大的發現！

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
I'd better get back to the research...
No, we first must ^0000FFtreat those patients who need Sonia stems. Please bring them to me.^000000
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
我得回去繼續研究...
不，我們首先必須^0000FF治療那些需要索妮雅莖的病人。請把他們帶給我。^000000

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
^0000FFInstructor Rugen manages them^000000, so you can bring them to him.
Please hand me the document. I'll sign it for you.
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
^0000FF指導員 魯根負責管理他們^000000，所以你可以把他們帶給他。
請把這個檔案給我。我會為你簽字。

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
I'd better get back to my stem research. I'll ask someone else for assistance.
You lucked out this time. Better not make a habit of eating things off the ground.
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
我得回去繼續我的莖研究。我會找其他人幫忙。
這次你運氣好。最好不要養成吃地上東西的習慣。

scripts.translation:

我得回去繼續我的莖研究。我會找其他人幫忙。
這次你運氣好。最好不要養成吃地上東西的習慣。

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
Did you see Instructor Rugen?
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
你見到指導員 魯根了嗎？

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
Hah hah hah!
How did it go?
They worked, didn't they?
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
哈哈哈哈哈！
情況怎麼樣？
起作用了，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
I have high hopes for my research.
Your seemingly reckless decision has saved many lives.
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
我對我的研究寄予厚望。
你看似魯莽的決定，救了許多人的命。

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
With this, we'll soon be able to investigate that ^0000FFsuspicious cave^000000 from the inside out!
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
有了這個，我們很快就能從內部調查那個^0000FF可疑的洞穴^000000了！

scripts.text: What cave?
scripts.translation: 哪個洞穴？

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
Oh, the cave that releases the noxious gas.
The gas is ^0000FFso thick in the air, you can't see the cave entrance clearly^000000.
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
哦，就是那個釋放廢氣魔的洞穴。
空氣中的廢氣^0000FF太濃了，看不清洞口^000000。

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
Those who we gave the first batch of the vaccine already left to the cave.
We haven't heard from them yet. I'd like to believe it's a good sign.
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
我們給第一批疫苗的人已經出發去洞穴了。
還沒收到他們的訊息。我希望這是個好兆頭。

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
If it weren't two of you, I could have pulled all my hair out in frustration.
Good job, you guys!
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
如果不是你們兩個，我早就急得想拔光自己的頭髮了。
幹得好，你們！

scripts.text:
[Barget Tiblack]
Those who we gave the first batch of the vaccine already left to the cave.
We haven't heard from them yet. I'd like to believe it's a good sign.
scripts.translation:
[巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克]
我們給第一批疫苗的人已經出發去洞穴了。

Good job, you guys!
scripts.translation:

如果不是你們兩個，我早就急得想拔光自己的頭髮了。
幹得好，你們！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Hm...
We don't have time for this!
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
嗯...
沒時間閒聊了！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
^0000FFWhen you collect 25 Sonia stems, meet me here^000000.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
^0000FF收集25株索妮雅莖後，來這裡見我^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I don't remember this rock was so big.
Or seeing these strange things around it.
I also smell ^0000FFsmoke^000000.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
我不記得這塊岩石有這麼大。
也沒見過周圍有這些奇怪的東西。
我還聞到了^0000FF煙味^000000。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Again,
I don't remember seeing ^0000FFso many strange animals and plants^000000 either.
These are Sonias, right? They weren't so many before.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
再說一次，
我也不記得見過^0000FF這麼多奇怪的動植物^000000。
這些是索妮雅，對吧？以前沒這麼多。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
If they were, I wouldn't have had to starve.
Sonias were the most delicious and least toxic among all the plants I tried.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
如果以前就有，我也不用捱餓了。
在我嘗過的所有植物中，索妮雅是最美味且毒性最低的。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
{0}, do you want to taste it?
I brought a few stems for memories' sake.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
{0}，你想嚐嚐嗎？
我帶了幾株莖，為了紀念。

scripts.text:
- Taste of Sonia -
Its thick, tongue-warming sap fills your mouth with delicious aroma.
scripts.translation:
- 索妮雅的味道 -
它濃稠、溫潤的汁液充滿你的口腔，散發出美味的香氣。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
What do you think?
Delicious, huh?
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
你覺得怎麼樣？
很美味，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I've got only a few left. Let's take turns to gather some more.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
我只剩幾株了。我們輪流去採集更多吧。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
I've got only a few left. Let's take turns to gather some more.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
我只剩幾株了。我們輪流去採集更多吧。

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Come on,
hurry over to ^0000FFInstructor Rugen^000000!
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
快一點，
趕緊去找^0000FF指導員 魯根^000000！

scripts.text:
[Tamarin]
Thank the gods, who knew that thing I ate out of hunger would save me?
Let's report to Barget.
scripts.translation:
[塔馬林]
謝天謝地，誰能想到我餓得吃下的那個東西能救我一命呢？
我們先去跟巴爾蓋特·蒂布萊克彙報吧。

Arrgh!

Ah...

啊...

The floor is dark. Watch your step!
scripts.translation:

地面很暗。小心腳下！

scripts.text:

Phew...
Why were you so reckless?
scripts.translation:

呼...
你為什麼這麼魯莽？

scripts.text: No, he looks too upset to talk.
scripts.translation: 不，他看起來太激動了，沒法說話。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Rugen]
Sigh...
This is just...
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
唉...
真是讓人...

scripts.text:
[Instructor Rugen]
How may I help you?
If you're seeking medical assistance, then please describe your symptoms at the reception desk and wait until help arrives.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
有什麼可以幫您的嗎？
如果您需要醫療援助，請到接待處描述您的症狀，然後等待救援人員到來。

scripts.text: Give Sonia stems.
scripts.translation: 給索妮雅餵食莖幹。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Rugen]
These aren't enough.
Could you check the number of your Sonia stems?
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
這些不夠。
請檢查一下您的索妮雅莖幹數量。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Rugen]
Are you serious?
Dr. Tiblack sent you, so I should believe you.
I'll feed these to the patients.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
你是認真的嗎？
既然蒂布拉克醫生派你來的，我就應該相信你。
我會把這些餵給病人。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Rugen]
Are you serious?
Dr. Tiblack sent you, so I should believe you.
I'll feed these to the patients.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
你是認真的嗎？
既然蒂布拉克醫生派你來的，我就應該相信你。
我會把這些餵給病人。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Rugen]
Oh!
Otto!
Can you see me?
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
哦！
奧托！
你能看見我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Otto]
Ugh...

[Instructor Rugen]
Oh!
It worked!
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
哦！
起作用了！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Rugen]
The patients are showing remarkable improvements, though they need to stay in bed for now.
I'll feed the stems to the most critical patients, and wait for Dr. Tiblack to finish her research.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
病人的狀況有了顯著改善，不過他們現在還需要臥床休息。
我會把莖幹餵給病情最嚴重的病人，並等待蒂布拉克醫生完成研究。

scripts.text:
[Instructor Rugen]
I'll give you a report on the patients' responses to the stem. Please bring the report to ^0000FFDr. Tiblack^000000.
Hah hah.
It worked!
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
我會給你一份關於病人對莖幹反應的報告。請把報告帶給^0000FF蒂布拉克醫生^000000。
哈哈。
起作用了！

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

哈哈。
起作用了！

scripts.text:
[Instructor Rugen]
I'm glad that the research resulted in our favor.
My comrades are well on their way to a full recovery.
Thank to you.
scripts.translation:
[指導員 魯根]
很高興研究結果對我們有利。
我的同志們正在完全康復的路上。
謝謝你。

呃...

[Advance Base Defender]
This place is too dangerous. Return to the base, now!
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守衛]
這裡太危險了。立刻返回基地！

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
I'll see that no monster sneak into the base.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守衛]
我會確保沒有魔物潛入基地。

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
Sigh, how long do I have to do this?
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守衛]
唉，我還要在這裡站多久啊？

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
Don't worry. I'm here to protect you.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守衛]
別擔心。我會保護你的。

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
We're in the middle of the battlefield. I can't talk for too long.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守衛]
我們正處於戰場中心，不能聊太久。

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
Please step aside. You're blocking my vision.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守衛]
請讓一下。你擋住我的視線了。

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
If you have time for chit-chat, then kill one more enemy instead.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守衛]
既然有時間閒聊，不如再去消滅一個敵人。

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
Bah, I'm cold and hungry... Oh, I was just talking to myself.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守衛]
真是的，又冷又餓...啊，我剛才是在自言自語。

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
Be careful: this place is overrun with dangerous monsters.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守衛]
小心：這裡到處都是危險的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Advance Base Defender]
For every monster I kill, one or more appear to take its place.
scripts.translation:
[前哨基地守衛]
我每消滅一隻魔物，就會有一隻或更多新的魔物出現。

scripts.text: [Advance Base Defender]
scripts.translation: [前哨基地守衛]

scripts.text: - Cannot progress with the dialogue because you have too many items. -
scripts.translation: - 由於物品欄已滿，無法繼續對話。 -

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
You look super weak!
Why are you here??
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
你看起來好弱啊！
為什麼來這裡？

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Well, there are not enough people!
But we will wait until you reach level 150.
Please come back later!
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
嗯，人手不足！
但我們會等你達到150級。
請稍後再來！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Have you noticed it, too?
Yes, the monsters in this area are really quite strange.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
你也注意到了嗎？
是的，這個區域的魔物確實很奇怪。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
They appear to be mutant versions of Midgard monsters
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
它們似乎是米德加爾特魔物的變異版本。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Worse still, their number has been rapidly increasing.
We must keep an eye on them.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
更糟糕的是，它們的數量正在迅速增加。
我們必須密切關注它們。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
To my regret, everyone seems so busy that I can't ask them for help, despite the seriousness of the investigation.
This is not a safe environment.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
遺憾的是，大家都太忙了，儘管調查工作很緊急，我還是無法請求他們的幫助。
這裡的環境並不安全。

scripts.text: What's going on?
scripts.translation: 發生了什麼？

scripts.text: Why can't you do it yourself?
scripts.translation: 為什麼你自己不做？

scripts.text: Do you want me to do it?
scripts.translation: 你想讓我去做嗎？

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
The environmental characteristics of this area are making the investigation too difficult.
The scenery looks familiar, yet in a way... strange.
The place looks like it's on the verge of utter collapse but.. I can see bursts of vibrant growth.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
這個地區的環境特徵讓調查變得異常困難。
這裡的景色看起來很熟悉，卻又透著一種...怪異。
這個地方看起來彷彿隨時會徹底崩塌，但...我卻又看到了蓬勃的生命力。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
What is this place?
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
這究竟是個什麼地方？

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Like everyone else from a noble background,
I only know how to command others.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
和所有出身名門的人一樣，
我只懂得如何命令別人。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Of all those monsters,
^0000FFFire Condors^000000 look most dangerous.
Those birds with burning tails charge headlong toward everyone they see. You may be able to run from them, but you will always get singed.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
在所有那些魔物中，
^0000FF火焰禿鷹^000000看起來最危險。
那些拖著燃燒尾巴的鳥會徑直衝向它們看到的每一個人。你或許能跑開，但一定會被燒焦。

scripts.text: Do you want me to hunt Fire Condors?
scripts.translation: 你想讓我去獵殺火焰禿鷹嗎？

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
No, I have no one to dispose their carcasses.
My purpose is, after all, an investigation.
Just bring me
15 ^FF0000Burning Feathers^000000
from ^0000FFFire Condors^000000.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
不，我沒有人手去處理它們的屍體。
畢竟，我的職責是進行調查。
只要從^0000FF火焰禿鷹^000000身上收集
15個^FF0000火焰羽毛^000000帶給我就行。

scripts.text: I'm as busy as you!
scripts.translation: 我也和你一樣忙！

scripts.text: Got it.
scripts.translation: 明白了。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
You acted as if you'd help me.
Were you messing with me?
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
你剛才表現得好像要幫我一樣。
你是在耍我嗎？

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Bring me
^FF000015 Burning Feathers^000000
from ^0000FFFire Condors^000000.
Hurry before more people fall victim to those vicious birds!
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
從^0000FF火焰禿鷹^000000身上收集
^FF000015個火焰羽毛^000000帶給我。
快一點，在更多人成為那些維舍斯鳥類的受害者之前！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
I thought you'd be hard at work by now,
gathering ^FF000015 Burning Feathers^000000
from ^0000FFFire Condors^000000,
so I called an emergency meeting of
my investigators.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
我本以為你現在應該正在努力工作，
從^0000FF火焰禿鷹^000000身上收集^FF000015個火焰羽毛^000000，
所以我召集了我的調查員們開了個緊急會議。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
And you're still in town,
enjoying a leisurely walk.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
而你卻還在城鎮裡，
悠閒地散步。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
You brought
all the ^FF000015 Burning Feathers^000000.
Thank you. Now I can
proceed with my investigation.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
你帶來了
全部^FF000015個火焰羽毛^000000。
謝謝。現在我可以
繼續我的調查了。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Most of all, I can finally enjoy the warmth of a fire!
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
最重要的是，我終於可以享受篝火的溫暖了！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Did you notice the worrisome expression on my face?
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
你注意到我臉上擔憂的表情了嗎？

scripts.text: Nope. Never.
scripts.translation: 沒有。完全沒注意到。

scripts.text: I did, instantly.
scripts.translation: 注意到了，立刻就看出來了。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
That's not the answer I expected,
but I'll continue with the spiel
I've prepared.
Sigh...
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
這不是我預期的回答，
但我還是繼續念我準備好的臺詞吧。
唉...

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
A scout hasn't returned
from the Flaming Basin.
I want you to go check
what happened to him.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
一名偵察兵從烈焰盆地出發後就沒有回來。
我想讓你去檢視一下他發生了什麼。

scripts.text: No can do.
scripts.translation: 做不到。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
I know you'll do it anyway!
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
我知道你反正會去做的！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
The scout headed for the area teeming with monsters.
Keep your eyes peeled for him.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
那名偵察兵前往了魔物聚集的區域。
請留意他的動向。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Not bad! You guys....
Please eat three bowls of gongs!
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
幹得不錯！你們……
請吃三碗貢湯！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
A scout hasn't returned
from the Flaming Basin.
I want you to go check
what happened to him.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
一名偵察兵從烈焰盆地出發後就沒有回來。
我想讓你去檢視一下他發生了什麼。

scripts.text: No can do.
scripts.translation: 做不到。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 當然。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
I know you'll do it anyway!
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
我知道你反正會去做的！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
The scout headed for the area teeming with monsters.
Keep your eyes peeled for him.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
那名偵察兵前往了魔物聚集的區域。
請留意他的動向。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
I sent you out to look for the scout.
Did you come back or haven't you left at all?
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
我派你們去找那名偵察兵。
你們到底是回來了，還是根本沒出發？

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Go look for the scout in the place teeming with monsters!
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
去魔物聚集的地方找那名偵察兵！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Did you find the scout?
He's resting and rewriting his scout journal?
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
你們找到那名偵察兵了嗎？
他正在休息並重寫偵察日誌？

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
He does not disappoint me.
He's a good soldier!
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
他真沒讓我失望。
他是個好士兵！

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Now that we've found the missing scout,
I want you to move on to the next mission.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
既然找到了失蹤的偵察兵，
我想讓你們繼續下一個任務。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
You know the number of mysterious monsters
in this Flaming Basin has been continuously increasing.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
你們知道，這片烈焰盆地中
神秘魔物的數量一直在持續增加。

scripts.text: I know.
scripts.translation: 我知道。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Things could quickly go out of control
if they expand to the outside world.
If they encounter other monsters in Midgard or the Other World,
they could go on a rampage,
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
如果它們擴散到外部世界，
局勢很快就會失控。
如果它們在米德加爾特或異世界遇到其他魔物，
可能會大鬧一場，

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
could spread deadly virus,
could procreate powerful mutants,
or worse.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
可能會傳播致命病毒，
可能會繁殖出強大的變異體，
或者更糟糕的情況。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
For now, the best solution would be
a large cull, and I want you to do it.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
目前，最好的解決辦法是
進行大規模清除，我想讓你們去做。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Please exterminate
20 ^0000FFFire Sandmen^000000
and ^0000FFFire Frilldoras^000000.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
請消滅
20只 ^0000FF火焰沙人^000000
和 ^0000FF火焰傘蜥^000000。

scripts.text: Do it yourself!
scripts.translation: 你自己去！

scripts.text: I'll do my best.
scripts.translation: 我會盡力。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
I hate to repeat myself,
but like everyone else from a noble background,
I only know how to command others.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
我不喜歡重複自己，
但和所有出身貴族的人一樣，
我只知道如何命令別人。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Hurry, those monsters are breeding even as we speak.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
快一點，那些魔物此刻正在繁殖。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Please exterminate
20 ^0000FFFire Sandmen^000000
and 20 ^0000FFFire Frilldoras^000000.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
請消滅
20只 ^0000FF火焰沙人^000000
和 20只 ^0000FF火焰傘蜥^000000。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
You exterminated
20 ^0000FFFire Sandmen^000000
and 20 ^0000FFFire Frilldoras^000000 as I ordered.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
你們按照我的命令消滅了
20只 ^0000FF火焰沙人^000000
和 20只 ^0000FF火焰傘蜥^000000。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
Thanks to you we've found an effective wayto deal with the monsters.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
多虧你們，我們找到了對付這些魔物的有效方法。

scripts.text:
[Base Investigator]
From this moment on, my soldiers will take over.
scripts.translation:
[基地調查員]
從這一刻起，將由我計程車兵們接手。

A horde of monsters surrounded me, keeping me from leaving,

You're afraid I might ask for help,
I see.
scripts.translation:

看來你怕我會向你求助啊。

scripts.text:

but ^0000FFFire Sandmen^000000 stole
my ^FF0000scout journal^000000.
scripts.translation:

我除了幾處擦傷外並無大礙，

我的 ^FF0000偵察日誌^000000。

scripts.text:

Without the ^FF0000scout journal^000000, I can't go back.
I'll be lucky
if my superiors don't court-martial me.
scripts.translation:

沒有 ^FF0000偵察日誌^000000，我就無法回去。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

Please bring me
20 ^FF0000Scout Journals^000000.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

My wounds are throbbing from the thought of punishment
that might await me at the base.
scripts.translation:
[偵察兵]
一想到基地裡等待我的懲罰，

scripts.text:
