The gun is good!
The HODE is evil!
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
槍是好的！
蚯蚓是邪惡的！

scripts.text: What god do you serve?
scripts.translation: 你們侍奉哪位神？

scripts.text: Who are you?
scripts.translation: 你是誰？

scripts.text: Go back!
scripts.translation: 回去吧！

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
We serve the God of Destruction!
He oversees the destruction of everything--from the destruction of a star to that of an entire galaxy,
and from the spoilage of my breakfast to that of my dinner.
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
我們侍奉毀滅之神！
他掌管著萬物的毀滅——從恆星的消亡到整個星系的終結，
從我早餐的變質到我晚餐的腐敗。

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
We're the Doom Prayers!
We serve the God of Destruction,
and pray to him to bless us with the end of the world.
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
我們是末日祈禱團！
我們侍奉毀滅之神，
祈禱他賜予我們世界末日的恩澤。

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
Only after everything else is destroyed,
we can be truly blessed.
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
只有當一切都被毀滅之後，
我們才能獲得真正的祝福。

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
Those sudden cracks
in the ground.
Those talking Cats.
Those green giants.
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
地面上突然出現的裂縫。
那些會說話的貓。
那些綠色的巨人。

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
They prove the end is near!
Oh, doomsday has arrived!
Destruction is a blessing!
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
它們證明了末日將近！
哦，末日已經降臨！
毀滅即是祝福！

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
No, we won't!
Finally, doomsday has arrived!
We've been dying for the blessing!
I want to be there before everyone else!
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
不，我們不會！
終於，末日降臨了！
我們一直渴望這份祝福！
我要趕在所有人之前到達那裡！

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
Hell no, we won't go!
Let us in there!
We've been chosen by the God of Destruction.
Unlike you, we're invincible!
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
絕對不行，我們不會走！
讓我們進去！
我們是被毀滅之神選中的人。
不像你們，我們是無敵的！

scripts.text: Can you prove it?
scripts.translation: 你能證明嗎？

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
How dare you challenge me?!
All right, I'll prove it to you!
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
你竟敢挑釁我？！
好吧，我就證明給你看！

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
Search this Doomsland and find ^FF000040 Blessing Stones^000000.
Throw them at us, and you'll see.
scripts.translation:

去這片末日之地尋找^FF000040塊祝福之石^000000。
把它們扔向我們，你就會明白了。

scripts.text:

Destruction is a blessing!
scripts.translation:

當它們擊中我們的身體時，
會伴隨著巨大的聲響變成花瓣！
毀滅即是祝福！

scripts.text: Doomsland?
scripts.translation: 末日之地？

scripts.text:
[Guard]
That's what those crazy people call this Flaming Basin.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
那是那群瘋子對這片火焰盆地的稱呼。

scripts.text:
[Guard]
And what they call ^FF0000Blessing Stones^000000 are simply the debris fell off ^0000FFFire Golems^000000.
scripts.translation:
[衛兵]
而他們所謂的^FF0000祝福之石^000000，不過是^0000FF火焰巨石怪^000000掉落的碎片罷了。

scripts.text:
The only way to send away these crazy people must be prove them they're wrong.
Do you want to hunt ^0000FFFire Golems^000000
and collect 40 ^FF0000Blessing Stones^000000?
scripts.translation:
趕走這群瘋子的唯一方法，就是證明他們是錯的。

並收集40塊^FF0000祝福之石^000000嗎？

scripts.text: No, I couldn't care less!
scripts.translation: 不，我才沒興趣！

scripts.text: I'll collect the stones.
scripts.translation: 我會去收集石頭的。

Stop bothering me and scram!
Destruction is a blessing!
scripts.translation:

看來你害怕目睹我們神明的恩典，以免改變你的想法。
別煩我了，快滾！
毀滅即是祝福！

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
Go ahead, bring ^FF0000Blessing Stones^000000 and throw them at us!
You'll see those stones turning into falling flower petals!
Then you'll cry and beg me to let you join us.
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
去吧，帶著^FF0000祝福之石^000000來砸向我們！
你會看到那些石頭變成飄落的花瓣！
然後你就會哭著求我讓你加入我們。

scripts.translation:

疼死我了！天哪！

scripts.text:

Aww! Err!
scripts.translation:

啊呀——！
哎喲！疼疼疼！

STOP! Stop hitting me in the face!
scripts.translation:

好痛！

scripts.translation:

兄弟姐妹們，冷靜下來！
那個異端分子用錯誤的石頭欺騙了我們！

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

You're a coward!
I command you again.
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
你真是個膽小鬼！
我再次命令你。

scripts.text:
[Doom Prayers Leader]
Bring the blood of the monsters that roam Doomsland.
I shall drink it and levitate to guide you all to the true faith!
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
帶來那些在末日之地遊蕩的魔物的血液。
我將飲用它並升空，引導你們所有人走向真正的信仰！

scripts.text:

from ^0000FFFire Frilldoras^000000 and and ^0000FFFire Sandmen^000000.

我能感覺到你對於見證毀滅之神恩典的恐懼。

scripts.text:

Destruction is a blessing!
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
別煩我了，快滾！
毀滅即是祝福！

scripts.text:

Hunt those heinous ^0000FFFire Frilldoras^000000 and and ^0000FFFire Sandmen^000000, and bring me 30 ^FF0000Monster Bloods^000000.
scripts.translation:
[末日祈禱團首領]
現在去給我帶怪獸血液來！
獵殺那些邪惡的^0000FF火焰傘蜥^000000和^0000FF火焰沙人^000000，給我帶來30瓶^FF0000怪獸血液^000000。
